commandHelp.shikin:
Usage: shikin [options] [command]

Shikin — control your finances from the command line

Options:
  -V, --version                                   output the version number
  -h, --help                                      display help for command

Commands:
  diagnose [options]                              Validate shared database connectivity and print CLI/MCP health details
  tools [options]                                 Return machine-readable command discovery metadata
  validate [options] <commandName> [args...]      Validate another command without executing it
  web [options]                                   Serve the packaged Shikin web app and data API on loopback for Tailscale Serve
  record [options] <entry...>                     Parse a natural-language transaction entry and return a confirmation preview
  correct-transaction-metadata [options]          Audited metadata-only correction, including finalized ordinary rows. Null explicitly clears optional fields; omission preserves them. Optional splits explicitly replace allocations; classified allocations must be cleared first. Never changes original source, note, import identity or balances.
  set-transaction-consumption [options]           Set an explicit allocation-level consumption classification. Choose one builtin role or one active custom type/current revision. Refund/principal treatments require a same-currency purchase classification; each treatment has an independent aggregate cap.
  clear-transaction-consumption [options]         Clear an explicit classification only when no refund/principal references it. Does not change ledger rows or balances.
  add-transaction [options]                       Add a new financial transaction (expense, income, or transfer). Use this when the user wants to record spending, earnings, or money movement between accounts.
  bind-transaction-import-identity [options]      Preview and explicitly bind verified source/external-ID identity to one legacy transaction without inferring original financial content.
  update-transaction [options]                    Update an existing transaction. Use this when the user wants to change the amount, description, category, date, or other details of a transaction.
  delete-transaction [options]                    Delete a transaction. Use this when the user wants to remove a transaction. The account balance will be adjusted accordingly.
  query-transactions|list-transactions [options]  Search and exhaustively traverse transactions with a bounded, snapshot-consistent keyset cursor.
  match-transfer-transactions [options]           Preview or atomically link an exact expense/income pair as one transfer while preserving the imported mirror as archived provenance.
  unmatch-transfer-transactions [options]         Preview or atomically reverse a matched transfer, restoring the source expense and archived income mirror without deleting statement provenance.
  tag-transaction [options]                       Add a tag to an existing transaction using the transaction tags JSON field.
  untag-transaction [options]                     Remove a tag from an existing transaction.
  list-tags [options]                             List transaction tags with usage counts.
  create-placeholder-transaction [options]        Create an unresolved placeholder transaction when the amount is known but final merchant/category details are not yet confirmed.
  list-placeholder-transactions [options]         List transactions marked as placeholders, optionally filtered by placeholder status.
  resolve-placeholder-transaction [options]       Resolve an unresolved placeholder by updating the original transaction with final known details while preserving placeholder audit metadata.
  split-placeholder-transaction [options]         Resolve an unresolved placeholder into multiple concrete transactions whose amounts exactly equal the original placeholder amount.
  get-spending-summary [options]                  Scoped gross, net consumption, or separate recurring planning equivalents.
  list-accounts [options]                         List all active accounts. Use this when the user asks about their accounts, balances, or needs to pick an account.
  create-account [options]                        Create a new financial account. Use this when the user wants to add a bank account, credit card, cash wallet, or other account.
  upsert-account [options]                        Idempotently create or update an account by accountId, account name, or account alias. Returns whether the account was created or updated.
  update-account [options]                        Update an existing account. Use this to change the name, type, currency, balance, credit limit, or billing dates of an account.
  set-account-alias [options]                     Assign a friendly alias to an existing account so future commands can use --account instead of a long account ID.
  balance-snapshot [options]                      Record an observed account balance as a snapshot without treating it as income or expense.
  reconcile [options]                             Preview/apply end-of-day observed balance reconciliation, retaining later activity. Nonzero changes crossing later anchors reject.
  finalize-staged-statement-history [options]     Finalize exact posted/cleared ordinary staged membership with independent coverage. Batch compatibility selects only posted/cleared rows; pending holds never auto-promote.
  settle-staged-transactions [options]            Deliberately settle exact pending ordinary staged rows to posted/cleared. Leaves them staged and balance-neutral; preserves financial/source identity.
  set-source-coverage [options]                   Create or explicitly revise independent printed-period source evidence, including zero-row periods and gaps. Does not finalize transactions.
  list-source-coverage [options]                  Read independent source coverage. Transaction date extrema are never coverage proof.
  supersede-reconciliation-bridge [options]       Preview a protected bridge replacement; apply requires its exact reviewed token. Preserves original evidence, every later anchor and current stored/effective balances.
  delete-account [options]                        Delete or archive an account. If the account has linked transactions it will be archived instead of deleted.
  list-categories [options]                       List available transaction categories. Use this when the user asks about categories or needs to pick one.
  get-balance-overview [options]                  Get a complete balance overview including total balance, per-account breakdown, and month-over-month change.
  analyze-spending-trends [options]               Analyze spending trends over multiple months with category breakdowns and trend detection.
  get-credit-card-status [options]                Get credit card status including credit utilization, persisted statement balances, minimum payments, payment status, due dates, and current-period spending.
  record-card-payment [options]                   Record or preview a credit-card payment as an accounting transfer, cleanup expense, or statement-only payment update.
  link-card-statement-payment [options]           Allocate an existing eligible posted payment transaction to a credit-card statement without creating transactions or changing account balances.
  unlink-card-statement-payment [options]         Void a statement payment allocation while retaining immutable historical IDs. Does not delete or change its transaction or account balances.
  list-card-statement-payment-links [options]     List active or historical credit-card statement payment evidence. This is a read-only operation.
  credit-card-cycle-explain [options]             Explain a credit-card statement cycle, due-date status, next upcoming due date, and optional purchase-date classification.
  create-credit-card-statement [options]          Create a persisted credit-card statement with closing/due dates, statement balance, minimum payment, paid amount, status, source, and note.
  update-credit-card-statement [options]          Update a persisted credit-card statement, including paid amount and payment status.
  list-credit-card-statements [options]           List persisted credit-card statements with payment amounts and statuses.
  delete-credit-card-statement [options]          Delete a persisted credit-card statement with a dry-run preview.
  create-budget [options]                         Create a scoped budget; optional budgetId makes identical replays a no-op.
  upsert-budget [options]                         Idempotently create or update a scoped budget.
  get-budget-status [options]                     Inspect current-definition budget usage in inclusive resolved windows.
  delete-budget [options]                         Delete a budget. Use this when the user wants to remove a budget they no longer need.
  get-net-worth [options]                         Calculate ownership-aware net worth. Returns native-currency components and only returns a converted total when ownership, verified prices, and FX are complete.
  manage-investment [options]                     Add, update, or delete an investment holding. Use this to track US/MX stocks, ETFs, crypto, bonds, CETES, mutual funds, and other investments.
  list-investments [options]                      List investment holdings with optional type, account, symbol, and text filters. Returns stable holding snapshots for CLI and MCP automation.
  get-upcoming-bills [options]                    Get upcoming bills from credit card due dates and recurring transactions. Returns a sorted list of bills due within the specified number of days.
  create-subscription [options]                   Create a subscription with optional account/category resolution and a dry-run preview.
  create-subscription-from-transaction [options]  Create a subscription using an existing transaction as the default source for amount, account, category, name, and currency.
  update-subscription [options]                   Update a subscription by ID with optional account/category resolution and a dry-run preview.
  delete-subscription [options]                   Delete a subscription by ID with a dry-run preview.
  list-subscriptions [options]                    List subscriptions stored in Shikin. Shows amounts, billing cycles, next payment dates, and monthly/yearly cost equivalents.
  get-subscription-spending [options]             Analyze subscription spending from Shikin data. Groups active subscriptions by category and billing cycle with monthly/yearly totals.
  write-notebook [options]                        Write or update a markdown note in the notebook. Use for research findings, portfolio reviews, market signals, and educational content.
  read-notebook [options]                         Read a note from the notebook. Use to reference previous research, reviews, or educational content.
  list-notebook [options]                         List notes and directories in the notebook. Use to discover available research, reviews, and educational content.
  generate-portfolio-review [options]             Generate a portfolio review and save it to the notebook. Reviews include performance summary, top/worst performers, and a holdings table.
  manage-category-rules [options]                 Manage auto-categorization rules. List learned rules, create new rules, delete rules, or suggest a category for a description.
  suggest-category [options]                      Suggest a category for a transaction description using the existing auto-categorization rules, optionally enqueueing the suggestion for review.
  review-suggestions [options]                    List queued category suggestions for review.
  approve-suggestion [options]                    Approve a queued category suggestion and optionally create or update a category rule for the approved pattern.
  reject-suggestion [options]                     Reject a queued category suggestion with optional source and note metadata.
  manage-recurring-transaction [options]          Create, update, delete, list, or toggle recurring transaction rules. Recurring rules automatically generate transactions on a schedule.
  materialize-recurring [options]                 Manually trigger materialization of due recurring transactions. Creates actual transactions for any recurring rules whose next_date has passed.
  get-recurring-expected-vs-paid [options]        Report expected recurring bills over a date range using the current next_date schedule with paid, unpaid, or late status. Uses recurring_rule_id links first and clearly marks conservative fallback matches.
  get-spending-anomalies [options]                Detect and return spending anomalies such as unusual charges, duplicate transactions, spending spikes, and large transactions. Native detections are retained; mainConversion supplies dated main-currency statistics and provenance, with incomplete results withheld.
  get-forecasted-cash-flow [options]              Get native and main-currency cash flow forecasts showing projected balances, burn rate, and danger dates. Main planning estimates use today’s manual rates; historical realized inputs are converted per transaction date before averaging.
  backup-database|backup [options]                Create a consistent manual SQLite database backup under the Shikin app data backups directory.
  restore-database|restore [options]              Preview a Shikin SQLite restore by default. Pass apply:true to restore after validation and create a rollback backup.
  finance-profile [options]                       Get, set, or clear stable automation finance profile preferences stored in settings.
  import-transactions [options]                   Preview or apply a UTF-8 CSV import. Required columns: date, description, amount. Optional: type, category, notes, status, currency, source, note, externalId.
  export-data [options]                           Export core Shikin tables plus CLI QOL tables as deterministic JSON, CSV file map, or Markdown.
  undo [options]                                  Preview or apply a safe rollback for the latest matching transaction or credit-card-statement audit entry. Dry-run is the default; pass apply=true to write.
  finance-sanity-check [options]                  Run generic automation-safe finance checks for card statements, placeholders, duplicate-looking transactions, subscriptions, recurring rules, balances, uncategorized spending, and recent provenance writes.
  audit-list [options]                            List audit history entries with filters for automation-safe triage. Supports redaction of free-text before/after/source/note details.
  audit-show [options]                            Show one audit history entry by ID with optional free-text redaction.
  automation-context [options]                    Return one consolidated automation context payload for setup readiness, accounts, aliases, budgets, subscriptions, cards, recurring bills, support surfaces, and recent audits.
  create-bucket [options]                         Create a cashflow bucket for envelope-style allocation with dry-run support.
  list-buckets [options]                          List cashflow buckets with balances and allocation summaries.
  allocate-income [options]                       Allocate posted income into a cashflow bucket. Optional account inputs only validate source/currency; allocations persist bucket, optional transaction, amount, source, and note.
  update-bucket [options]                         Update cashflow bucket name, description, target, sort order, or active flag. IDs and allocation history are preserved. Use clearFields to null description or targetAmount.
  delete-bucket [options]                         Delete a cashflow bucket only when it is truly empty and has no allocation history. Funded or referenced buckets must be deactivated with update-bucket.
  reverse-bucket-allocation [options]             Append an equal negative reversal for a positive cashflow allocation. Original rows are preserved. Does not change real account balances or transactions.
  correct-bucket-allocation [options]             Atomically reverse an original cashflow allocation and insert a replacement or reallocation. Real account balances and transactions are never changed.
  setup-status [options]                          Show missing or incomplete setup that affects CLI and automation workflows.
  create-goal [options]                           Create a savings goal. Use this when the user wants to set a savings target, like an emergency fund, vacation, or big purchase.
  update-goal [options]                           Update a savings goal. Can add/withdraw saved amounts, change the target, deadline, or other details. Null or clear flags remove optional deadline, notes, and account; omission preserves them.
  get-goal-status [options]                       Get savings goal status showing progress toward each goal.
  get-financial-health-score [options]            Calculate the user's financial health score (0-100) with a breakdown across savings rate, budget adherence, debt-to-income, emergency fund, and spending consistency. Native scores are retained; mainConversion uses dated cash flow, current balances at today’s manual rates, and budgets in their durable currencies.
  get-spending-recap [options]                    Read a spending recap without saving. Gross cash flow by default; explicit net consumption is available with coverage status. Additive mainConversion retains transaction-date manual-rate provenance and incomplete/known amounts; saved recap text remains native.
  save-spending-recap [options]                   Explicitly save a spending recap. Writes only recaps and audit_log; identity includes type, period, all-currencies scope and selected basis. Unchanged re-saves are no-ops.
  get-education-tip [options]                     Get a contextual financial education tip. Use this when the user asks about financial concepts or when educational context would enhance the conversation.
  get-debt-payoff-plan [options]                  Calculate a debt payoff plan using snowball or avalanche strategy. Pulls credit card debts from accounts automatically; MVP projections use 0% APR because accounts do not store APR yet.
  convert-currency [options]                      Convert an amount with an effective-dated manual direct rate. No provider, inverse, triangulation, or future fallback is used.
  split-transaction [options]                     Audited split correction across multiple categories. Amounts remain in the main currency unit. Finalized ordinary rows are supported; protected provenance and dependent evidence require their dedicated workflows.
  manage-receivable [options]                     Create, update, cancel, or delete a receivable. Amount inputs and display fields use main currency units; stored values use centavos.
  list-receivables [options]                      List receivables with lifecycle, due-date, payer, account, overdue, and text filters. Returns stable centavo and display fields.
  match-receivable [options]                      Preview or apply a posted/cleared income transaction against an open receivable. Matching defaults to dry-run; set apply to true to write.
  unmatch-receivable [options]                    Preview or atomically detach a matched income transaction from a receivable while preserving both records.
  get-runtime-diagnostics [options]               Read build, schema, database lineage, local-instance identity, revision, and last financial write diagnostics without changing storage.
  get-currency-settings [options]                 Read the explicitly configured database-backed main currency. An absent main currency is reported as unconfigured.
  set-main-currency [options]                     Explicitly save the database-backed main reporting currency. This never relabels accounts, transactions, plans, snapshots, or other records.
  list-exchange-rates [options]                   List the complete immutable manual direct-rate history, including corrected rows and effective dates.
  set-exchange-rate [options]                     Append an effective-dated direct manual rate or immutable correction. Backdating and corrections require an audit note and explicit historical-change acknowledgement.
  list-classification-types [options]             Discover fixed economic effects, eligible directions, reference requirements, active custom heads, immutable history, and Receivables/investment/card-payment workflow boundaries. Read-only.
  create-classification-type [options]            Create an audited named type mapped to one fixed financial treatment. No custom formula or transaction mutation.
  revise-classification-type [options]            Append an immutable named-type revision after checking the expected current head. Existing assignments remain pinned.
  archive-classification-type [options]           Archive a custom type after checking its current head. Historical pinned assignments and reports remain valid.
  preview-consumption-classifications [options]   Read-only atomic preview for 1-100 explicit allocations. Validates final-state direction, references, independent caps, dependents, custom heads, and protected workflows; never approves review state.
  apply-consumption-classifications [options]     Atomically apply the exact reviewed classification preview. Rejects stale database identity/revision/evidence/type heads and performs no partial writes.
  list-plugins [options]                          List local Shikin plugins discovered under the app data extensions directory.
  enable-plugin [options]                         Enable a trusted-local plugin after explicitly approving its declared permissions.
  disable-plugin [options]                        Disable a local plugin so its tools no longer appear in new CLI/MCP catalogs.
  help [command]                                  display help for command
commandHelp.diagnose:
Usage: shikin diagnose [options]

Validate shared database connectivity and print CLI/MCP health details

Options:
  --deep      Run read-only integrity, foreign-key, migration, and balance
              checks
  --json      Print compact JSON output
  --pretty    Print pretty JSON output (default)
  --quiet     Suppress successful output; failures still print JSON
  --redacted  Redact future sensitive fields from output
  -h, --help  display help for command
commandHelp.tools:
Usage: shikin tools [options]

Return machine-readable command discovery metadata

Options:
  --json      Print compact JSON output
  --pretty    Print pretty JSON output (default)
  --quiet     Suppress successful output; failures still print JSON
  --redacted  Redact future sensitive fields from output
  -h, --help  display help for command
commandHelp.validate:
Usage: shikin validate [options] <commandName> [args...]

Validate another command without executing it

Arguments:
  commandName  Command to validate
  args         Command options to validate

Options:
  --json       Print compact JSON output
  --pretty     Print pretty JSON output (default)
  --quiet      Suppress successful output; failures still print JSON
  -h, --help   display help for command
commandHelp.web:
Usage: shikin web [options]

Serve the packaged Shikin web app and data API on loopback for Tailscale Serve

Options:
  --port <port>  Loopback port to serve (1024-65535) (default: "8480")
  -h, --help     display help for command
commandHelp.record:
Usage: shikin record [options] <entry...>

Parse a natural-language transaction entry and return a confirmation preview

Arguments:
  entry                       Natural-language transaction entry

Options:
  --apply                     Apply the parsed transaction noninteractively
  --dry-run                   Validate and preview the parsed transaction
                              without writing it
  --strict                    Fail when natural-language parsing is ambiguous or
                              low-confidence
  --min-confidence <value>    Minimum parse confidence from 0 to 1 before
                              recording
  --require-explicit-type     Require income or expense intent to be explicit
  --require-explicit-account  Require account via flag or account phrase
  --require-explicit-amount   Require an explicit amount in the entry
  --allow-duplicate           Apply even when an exact or likely duplicate is
                              detected
  --account <value>           Account alias, exact account ID, or exact account
                              name
  --account-id <value>        Canonical account ID
  --category <value>          Category name override
  --status <status>           Transaction status: pending, posted, or cleared
  --notes <value>             User transaction notes
  --source <value>            Automation source or origin label for transaction
                              provenance
  --note <value>              Workflow changelog note for transaction provenance
  --json                      Print compact JSON output
  --pretty                    Print pretty JSON output (default)
  --quiet                     Suppress successful output; failures still print
                              JSON
  --redacted                  Redact future sensitive fields from output
  -h, --help                  display help for command
